MessageTypes.label: Motor 1 - angle (degrees)
MessageTypes.description:
Needle angle for the output labelled Motor1 on the PoStep board.
$ = 0 to 315 degrees from the zero stop, decimals allowed (1/12 degree resolution).
Use the Interpolation modifier to map the sim value onto the dial.

MessageTypes.label: Home
MessageTypes.description:
Drives needles into the zero stop and re-zeroes them, takes about 4 seconds.
$ = 0 homes all motors, 1 to 8 homes that motor only.
Runs every time this message is sent, so drive it from a value that changes when you want to home.

MessageTypes.label: Max speed (all boards)
MessageTypes.description:
$ = max needle speed in degrees per second, 30 to 400. Default 280.
Overrides the device config string until the board restarts.

MessageTypes.label: Acceleration (all boards)
MessageTypes.description:
$ = acceleration in degrees per second squared, 0 = no ramp (instant full speed). Default 3000.
Overrides the device config string until the board restarts.
